label: Teltonika TSW110
description: The five-port Gigabit switch from the TSW100 family with the PoE removed - unmanaged, fanless, DIN rail.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika wiki): described as an unmanaged Gigabit Ethernet switch and the non-PoE version of the TSW100, which carries five Gigabit ports. Modelled as five plain Gigabit RJ45 ports with no PoE.
